title: Blade the Vampire Hunter #5 Marvel 1994 Night Terror Direct Edition
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear. Small handwritten initials "D.T.W. S.B.M." on the cover beside the barcode (pictured).
descriptionText:
Blade: The Vampire-Hunter #5 (November 1994), Marvel Comics - face to face with Night Terror! Direct edition, $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: '94-95 Fleer NBA Basketball Series 1 ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear. Small handwritten initials ("D.T.W. S.B.M.") on the cover beside the barcode (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
